registry_rule: The identity of the certified populace-uk artifact a UK compute run must execute against. Committed so verification is OFFLINE and byte-exact: a run checks the artifact it was handed against this digest before constructing a simulation, rather than trusting a filename or a path.
provenance: Read from the release's own release_manifest.json in policyengine/populace-uk-private on 2026-09-07, and independently confirmed by downloading the artifact at that revision and hashing it.
why_this_bundle: It is the bundle the 14 existing UK results were computed against (run_id campaign-20260802-reckoner-t2, engine_version 2.89.2 in pe_results). A counterpart computed on a different bundle is not comparable to them.
engine_constraint_note: The bundle DECLARES policyengine-uk ==2.89.2. That is not this repo's preference; it is the data's own compatibility statement. Computing at a newer engine needs a NEW certified bundle, not a relaxed check — see #126.
